references.title: Multiparty Communication Complexity of Collision-Finding and Cutting Planes Proofs of Concise Pigeonhole Principles
references.note: Proves a 2^(Omega(n^(1/4))) lower bound for fully general dag-like Cutting Planes refutations of bit pigeonhole formulas, leaving the optimal exponent open.

references.title: On the Power and Limitations of Branch and Cut
references.note: Introduces central simulation and lower-bound questions for Stabbing Planes, proves a Cutting Planes simulation for bounded-coefficient SP*, and gives short proofs for finite-field systems.

references.title: Depth Lower Bounds in Stabbing Planes for Combinatorial Principles
references.note: Provides size and depth lower bounds for several Stabbing Planes settings but does not prove unrestricted superpolynomial size lower bounds.

references.title: Automating Cutting Planes is NP-Hard
references.note: Separates proof search from proof existence by proving hardness of automating Cutting Planes; it does not settle the size hypotheses in C005.

references.title: New Lower Bounds for Polynomial Calculus over Non-Boolean Bases
references.note: Strengthens finite-field extension-variable lower bounds through an arity-count tradeoff, while still leaving unrestricted recursively global support outside the theorem.

references.title: AC0[p]-Frege Cannot Efficiently Prove That Constant-Depth Algebraic Circuit Lower Bounds Are Hard
references.note: Proves that an explicit DNF family has no polynomial-size AC0[p]-Frege proofs infinitely often, while leaving open whether the DNFs are tautologies or non-tautologies.

references.title: A Strongly Exponential Separation of DNNFs from CNF Formulas
references.note: Provides explicit expander-based CNFs with strong DNNF lower bounds and motivates separator-preservation attacks, though H027 targets a different rewrite-to-treewidth model.

references.title: A Lower Bound for k-DNF Resolution on Random CNF Formulas via Expansion
references.note: Shows modern expansion-based lower bounds for stronger resolution systems on random CNFs and motivates mixed non-affine hard families, without covering H017's full compiler.

claim_boundary: Primary sources define the audited frontier and attack boundaries only; they do not certify the truth or novelty of JANUS entries.
